svg.title: Where surface motion holds
svg.desc: A zoning-free Oceanic Mollweide map of mean historical OSCAR surface-current vectors from 11 samples between 2018-01-01 and 2018-11-21. Color shows mean sampled speed and opacity shows directional persistence. OSW directional persistence measures alignment among sampled historical surface vectors. It is not a fixed current boundary, Lagrangian coherence, full-depth circulation, or heat transport.
svg.metadata: Source: NOAA PIFSC ERDDAP mirror of ESR OSCAR third-degree 5-day archive. Source SHA-256: 45f38936174ce1c7ef8b79396512a3d27d53a77a3df40d25a761ea73211f2b54. Diagnostic: magnitude(time-mean velocity) / time-mean(magnitude(velocity)).
